actions.add_list_items.description: Add people or companies to a list. Each identifier is resolved (LinkedIn URLs, company domains, emails, or graph IDs) and added. Returns detailed results per item.
actions.add_list_items.props.items.descr: Items to add to the list (max 100)
actions.check_company_paths.description: Quickly check if you have connections to a company without fetching full details. Returns whether paths exist, an overall score, count of reachable people, and avatar thumbnails.
actions.check_company_paths.props.domain: Company domain, e.g. "acme.com" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.check_company_paths.props.linked: LinkedIn company page URL, e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.check_company_paths.props.url.de: Generic company URL (auto-detected) (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.check_list_membership.descriptio: Check which lists contain the given entities. Returns a map of entity_id to the lists that contain it. Entities not in any list are omitted.
actions.check_list_membership.props.enti: Array of entity IDs (person or company IDs) to check membership for (max 1000)
actions.companies_refresh.description: Refresh/import company data from LinkedIn URLs or domains. Realtime mode returns enriched data synchronously (or times out after 25s); async mode returns job IDs for later status checking. At least one of linkedin_urls or domains must be provided.
Job IDs to check status for (returned by async refresh calls).
actions.companies_refresh.props.linkedin: LinkedIn company page URLs to refresh.
actions.companies_refresh.props.realtime: If true, wait for enrichment (up to ~25s) and return company data inline. If false, return job IDs immediately.
actions.create_list.description: Create a new list to organize people or companies. The creator becomes the list owner. List creation may be limited based on your subscription plan.
actions.create_list.props.is_public.desc: Whether the list is publicly accessible
actions.create_list.props.type.descripti: Type of entities in the list
actions.delete_list.description: Permanently delete a list and all its items. This action cannot be undone.
actions.enrich_company.description: Get detailed information about a company by domain, LinkedIn URL, or any URL. Returns name, website, LinkedIn URL, logo, employee count, industry, founded year, and description.
actions.enrich_company.props.domain.desc: Company domain, e.g. "example.com" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.enrich_company.props.linkedin_ur: LinkedIn company page URL, e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.enrich_company.props.url.descrip: Generic company URL (auto-detected) (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.enrich_company_bulk.description: Get detailed information for up to 10 companies in a single request. Each result contains either company data or an error.
actions.enrich_company_bulk.props.identi: Up to 10 companies to look up. Each row specifies an identifier type and value.
actions.enrich_person.description: Get detailed profile information (name, headline, current company, location, photo, LinkedIn URL) for a person identified by LinkedIn URL or generic URL.
actions.enrich_person.props.linkedin_url: LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe (provide this OR url)
actions.enrich_person.props.url.descript: Generic URL — auto-detected (provide this OR linkedin_url)
actions.enrich_person_bulk.description: Get detailed profile information for up to 10 people in a single request. Partial results are returned if some lookups fail — check each result for success or error status.
actions.enrich_person_bulk.props.identif: Up to 10 people to enrich. Each row is one person.
actions.enrich_person_email.description: Find the email address for a person by LinkedIn URL or generic URL. Returns the verified email address if found, or null if unavailable.
actions.enrich_person_email.props.linked: LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe (provide this OR url)
actions.enrich_person_email.props.url.de: Generic URL — auto-detected (provide this OR linkedin_url)
actions.enrich_person_email_bulk.descrip: Find email addresses for up to 10 people in a single request. Returns email addresses where found, with error messages for failed lookups.
actions.enrich_person_email_bulk.props.i: Up to 10 people to look up emails for. Each row is one person.
actions.get_app_info.description: Get information about the partner application associated with your token — title, description, domain, logo URL, public key, and active flag. Useful for verifying your app configuration.
actions.get_company_paths.description: Find introduction paths to people at a specific company. Returns up to 50 employees you can reach through your network, ranked by connection strength.
actions.get_company_paths.props.connecti: Filter by connection degree (1=direct, 2=second-degree, 3=third-degree). Provide one or more values.
actions.get_company_paths.props.cursor.d: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)
actions.get_company_paths.props.domain.d: Company domain, e.g. "acme.com" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.get_company_paths.props.limit.de: Number of results per page (default 25, max 50)
actions.get_company_paths.props.linkedin: LinkedIn company page URL, e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.get_company_paths.props.url.desc: Generic company URL (auto-detected) (provide one of: domain, linkedin_url, url)
actions.get_current_user.description: Get profile information for the authenticated user — id, email, name, account creation date, sync completion status, and active flag. Useful for verifying auth and checking whether the user's network data is ready.
actions.get_list.description: Get a list with all its items. Returns the list metadata plus paginated items. For people lists, items are sorted by connection strength (warmth score).
actions.get_list.props.cursor.descriptio: Opaque cursor for items pagination (from previous response)
actions.get_person_paths.description: Find introduction paths to reach a specific person through your professional network. Provide a LinkedIn URL and get back direct connections, mutual contacts, and connection strength scores (0-100).
actions.get_person_paths.props.linkedin_: LinkedIn profile URL of the target person, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe (provide this OR url)
actions.get_person_paths.props.url.descr: Generic URL — auto-detected (provide this OR linkedin_url)
actions.get_person_paths_bulk.descriptio: Find introduction paths to multiple people in a single request. Provide up to 100 LinkedIn IDs (the slug after linkedin.com/in/) and get connection paths for each.
actions.get_person_paths_bulk.props.link: LinkedIn identifiers (e.g. "johndoe" from linkedin.com/in/johndoe). Max 100 per request.
actions.import_relationships.description: Import manual relationships to expand your network graph — useful for adding people you know but aren't connected to digitally. Provide email addresses or LinkedIn URLs with optional scores (0-10); higher scores indicate stronger relationships. Max 1000 per request.
actions.import_relationships.props.min_s: Default score (0-10) applied to rows without an explicit score.
actions.import_relationships.props.peopl: Up to 1000 people to import. Each row: identifier (email or LinkedIn URL), optional score (0-10), optional relationship type.
actions.join_group.description: Join a group using an invite link. Once joined, you gain access to the shared network of all group members.
actions.join_group.props.group_invite_li: The invite link code shared by a group admin or member
actions.join_team.description: Join a team using an invite link. Provide the invite link code (the part after /join/ in the URL).
actions.join_team.props.team_invite_link: The invite link code shared by a team admin (e.g. the part after /join/ in the invite URL)
actions.leave_group.description: Leave a group you are a member of. If you are the last member, the group is deleted. Admins must remove all other members before leaving.
actions.leave_group.props.group_id.descr: ID of the group to leave
actions.leave_team.description: Leave a team you are a member of. If you are the last member of a non-paid team, the team is deleted. Admins of paid teams cannot leave — use Cancel Plan instead.
actions.leave_team.props.team_id.descrip: ID of the team to leave
actions.list_companies.description: Get your top-connected companies ranked by network strength. Returns a paginated list with connection score, label, LinkedIn URL, domain, and enrichment data.
actions.list_companies.props.connection_: Filter by connection degree (1=direct, 2=second-degree, 3=third-degree). Provide one or more values.
actions.list_companies.props.cursor.desc: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)
actions.list_companies.props.limit.descr: Number of results per page (default 25, max 100)
actions.list_groups.description: Get all groups (communities) you are a member of. Groups allow members to share network access with each other, expanding everyone's reach.
actions.list_integrations.description: Get all your connected Gmail integrations, including rate limits, timezone, the default sending account, and whether you can add more based on your plan.
actions.list_lists.description: Get all your saved lists of people or companies. Supports pagination, filtering by type, and searching by title.
actions.list_lists.props.cursor.descript: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)
actions.list_people.description: Get your network contacts ranked by connection strength. Returns a paginated list with enrichment data, supporting cursor-based pagination and optional connection-degree filtering.
actions.list_people.props.company_domain: Filter by current company domain (exact match), e.g. "google.com"
actions.list_people.props.connection_deg: Filter by connection degree (1=direct, 2=second-degree, 3=third-degree). Provide one or more values.
actions.list_people.props.cursor.descrip: Opaque cursor for pagination (from previous response)
actions.list_people.props.limit.descript: Number of results per page (default 25, max 100)
actions.list_teams.description: Get all teams you are a member of. Each team includes id, name, logo, invite_link, and an is_admin flag indicating your admin status.
actions.people_refresh.description: Refresh or import people data from LinkedIn URLs. In realtime mode, returns enriched person data immediately (or times out after 25 seconds and converts to async). In async mode, returns job IDs for later status checking.
actions.people_refresh.props.linkedin_ur: LinkedIn profile URLs to refresh. At least one is required.
actions.people_refresh.props.realtime.de: If true, waits synchronously for results (up to 25s). If false, returns job IDs for async processing.
actions.remove_list_items.description: Remove items from a list by their item IDs (obtained from get_list). Returns the count of successfully removed items.
actions.remove_list_items.props.item_ids: Array of item IDs to remove from the list (max 100)
actions.resync_integration.description: Trigger a full resync of a Google or LinkedIn integration. Clears sync cursors and re-imports all contacts/calendar data; all graph operations use MERGE so it is fully idempotent.
actions.resync_integration.props.id.desc: Numeric ID of the integration to resync
actions.search_companies.description: Search for companies using natural language (in the "prompt" field) and/or structured filters. Returns matching companies with relevance and connection-strength scores; supports cursor-based pagination.
actions.search_companies.props.cursor.de: Pagination cursor (encoded string) from a previous response.
actions.search_companies.props.filters.d: Structured filters. Supported keys: name, domain, linkedinUrl, linkedinId, industry, companySize, companyType, country, city, foundedAfter, foundedBefore, keywords.
actions.search_companies.props.include_c: Inline count scope to compute on the first page only. Ignored when cursor is provided and adds latency.
actions.search_companies.props.limit.des: Maximum number of results per page (default 25, max 100)
actions.search_companies.props.mode.desc: Search mode: auto (let system decide), lookup (direct match), simple (LLM-powered), or complex (thinking + high-reasoning SQL generation).
actions.search_companies.props.prompt.de: Natural language search query, e.g. "Find B2B SaaS companies with 50-200 employees in California". Either prompt or filters must be provided.
actions.search_companies.props.scope.des: Search scope: network (connections first) or global (all companies).
actions.search_people.description: Search for people using natural language queries. Pass your search text in "prompt" (e.g. "engineers at Google"). Supports cursor-based pagination and structured filters.
actions.search_people.props.cursor.descr: Pagination cursor (encoded string from a previous response)
actions.search_people.props.filters.desc: Structured search filters as JSON (alternative or complement to prompt). Either prompt or filters must be provided.
actions.search_people.props.include_coun: Inline count scopes to compute on the first page only. Ignored when cursor is provided and adds latency.
actions.search_people.props.limit.descri: Maximum number of results per page (1-100, default 25)
actions.search_people.props.mode.descrip: Search execution mode. "auto" classifies the query. Use "lookup" for direct matches, "simple" for firmographic queries, and "complex" for multi-step queries.
actions.search_people.props.prompt.descr: Natural language search query (e.g. "Find CTOs at SaaS companies in San Francisco")
actions.search_people.props.scope.descri: "network" searches your connections first, "global" searches everyone, "specific_list" restricts to caller-provided identifiers (requires specific_list_data).
actions.search_people.props.specific_lis: Required when scope="specific_list". Caller-supplied candidate set (1..50,000 entries). Each entry is a bare LinkedIn identifier or { id, score? }.
actions.sort_companies.description: Rank a list of companies (up to 100 LinkedIn URLs or domains) by how well-connected you are to people there. Each result includes a score, label, LinkedIn URL, and domain.
actions.sort_companies.props.companies.d: Array of company URLs (LinkedIn URLs or domains), e.g. "https://linkedin.com/company/acme-corp" or "example.com". Max 100.
actions.sort_people.description: Rank a list of LinkedIn profile URLs by how well-connected you are to them. Returns each person sorted by connection strength (highest first), with score (0-100) and score_label.
actions.sort_people.props.people.descrip: Array of LinkedIn person profile URLs (e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe). At least one is required.
actions.update_integration.description: Update settings for a connected Gmail integration — adjust rate limits, timezone, status, or set as the default sending account. Provide only the fields you want to change.
actions.update_integration.props.email_s: Whether this should be the default integration for email sending
Minimum delay between emails in seconds (60-3600)
actions.update_integration.props.id.desc: Numeric ID of the integration to update
actions.update_list.description: Update a list's metadata. Provide at least one of: title or description. The list type cannot be changed after creation.
actions.update_list.props.description.de: New list description. Leave blank to keep unchanged.
actions.upsert_group.description: Create a new group or update an existing one. To create: provide a name (id is auto-generated). To update: provide group_id (requires admin permissions).
actions.upsert_group.props.group_id.desc: Existing group ID to update. Omit to create a new group.
actions.upsert_group.props.logo.descript: URL to the group logo image
actions.upsert_team.description: Create or update a team. The team ID is derived from the team name; repeated calls with the same name update the same team (requires admin permissions on update).
actions.upsert_team.props.logo.descripti: URL to the team logo image
auth.description: Your Village API token. Generate one from your Village settings and paste it here.
